observations: Photos show a full-size, cabinet-style sewing machine on a wooden table with foot pedal and metal base.
The machine head has a badge that appears to read 'Hercules' (brand text is small but visible in photo 1).
There are two large front knobs/dials and a handwheel on the right side of the machine head (photo 1 and photo 3).
The table has a built-in drawer/compartment and a metal vented platform below (photo 1 and photo 3).
There is visible wear/spotting on the machine body and table surface (photo 1 and photo 3).
No clear model number or specification plate is readable in the photos provided.

claims.evidence: Photos show some visible wear/spotting on the machine head and table; no close-up of working condition (stitching test, motor/needle movement) is shown.

risks.risk: Whether the machine actually works (needle movement, timing, feed, and stitching). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running with a needle threaded, sewing a straight line on fabric (show start-to-finish).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/possibly needing service (worst case for a used machine).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts (needle, bobbin case, presser foot, belt/drive components) or damaged internal timing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle + presser foot, bobbin case/bobbin, and the underside/drive area (and confirm included accessories list).

risks.risk: Condition of the motor/drive and pedal (if present) and whether it runs smoothly.
risks.proof: Video showing pedal engagement and smooth handwheel/needle motion without unusual noise or stalling.

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion or worn feed mechanism that may affect stitching quality.
risks.proof: Close-up of feed dogs and the inside throat area (under the needle plate) plus a stitching test result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may have wear affecting performance.

proof_requests: Send a video of the machine sewing (threaded needle, bobbin inserted, sewing on fabric) with clear start-to-finish footage.
Send close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, bobbin case/bobbin, and the feed dogs/needle plate area.
Confirm what accessories are included (needles, bobbins, presser feet, power source if any) and whether any parts are missing.
response.reason: The photos identify it as a Hercules-branded cabinet sewing machine, but the seller’s 'perfect condition' claim is not verifiable remotely because no stitching/operation proof is shown. The key price drivers (working condition, completeness, and internal timing) require a short sewing test video and close-ups.
